div.p: Map of every runtime flow in the issue-driven autonomous coding orchestrator. Each diagram renders in VS Code's Markdown preview and on GitHub.

Core pipeline in one line: GitHub issues → poll/ingest → triage → worktree agent run → publish (journaled) → QA personas → auto-merge (pollMergeQueue) → rebase cascade. The orchestrator now lands QA-passed PRs itself via gateway.mergePr (decision #69); human merge on github.com is still supported.

Assistant & outreach (Argus) pipeline: surfaces (terminal · voice · web · phone) → Gemma-first brain → Sonnet escalate → gated action tools, plus a batch outreach loop discovery → research → build (argus-demo) → draft → human approval → Resend email. Same process, separate pipeline, same durable SQLite state.
One process, multiple repos, durable SQLite state, crash-recovered on boot.

tr.td: End-to-end overview
How a GitHub issue becomes a merge-ready PR
Boot & Supervisor
src/main.ts is the composition root: it sequences env load → DB open/migrate → snapshot lo…
Task Lifecycle State Machine
Every state a task moves through from issue ingest to awaiting-human-merge, including all …
Ingest (Poll + Reconcile)
Periodic poller and on-demand reconciler both funnel all GitHub issue data through a singl…
GitHub Read Path
Conditional paginated issue polling with ETag 304 short-circuit and since-overlap dedup, f…
GitHub Write Path
Every GitHub mutation is journaled (intent row written to side_effects BEFORE the call), e…
Triage
Serial scanner queries Claude SDK for each untriaged issue, caches the verdict by (issue_i…
Scheduler
Every scheduling tick gate-checks pause/cost-ceiling/headroom, then issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE…
Workspace & Worktrees
Manages bare clones per repo and linked worktrees per task, with credential-isolated git o…
Agent Runner & Pool
A timer-driven concurrent pool claims ready tasks from SQLite, spawns one detached pipelin…
QA Personas & Rework Loop
Sequential reviewer personas produce free-form markdown, a strict CTO-summary persona emit…
Notifications & Actions
System-wide notification center persisting two-tier (gating/fyi) rows in SQLite with typed…
Server REST + SSE + Dashboard
Express server on 127.0.0.1 serves a REST API and a single SSE stream (/api/events) that p…
Stats, Snapshots & Maintenance
Usage samples are ingested via REST into usage_samples, aggregates are computed on-demand …
Argus Brain
Per-utterance two-tier reasoning: local Gemma (Ollama) first, escalate to Sonnet (Agent SDK), gated confirm on consequential tools
Argus I/O Surfaces
Terminal REPL, voice loop (Deepgram STT + chunked TTS), and web surface all feed one shared brain; announcer speaks gating notifications
Phone Server
Token-gated Express + WebSocket voice bridge (STT → brain → streaming TTS) booted by main.ts
Email
Outbound Resend send queue (journaled) + inbound Svix-verified webhook that suppresses bounced/complained contacts
Batch Outreach Pipeline
Batch worker drives items research → build (argus-demo issue) → draft → human approval → email send
Rebase Cascade
After a merge, re-merge sibling awaiting_merge branches; Sonnet resolver on conflicts, gating on semantic decisions

p.em: The whole pipeline: GitHub on the left, the SQLite-backed orchestrator in the middle, the human cockpit on the right. Solid arrows are the happy path; dotted arrows are events and recovery.

p.em: src/main.ts is the composition root: it sequences env load → DB open/migrate → snapshot loop → registry upsert → email gateway + batch worker + announcer + web Argus → HTTP server → (if PHONE_AUTH_TOKEN) phone server → (if token) label ensure → startup reconcile → poller → triage scanner → boot recovery → executor (now also pollMergeQueue) → hourly reconcile timer → daily retention timer, then registers SIGINT/SIGTERM drain handlers.

div.p: Triggers: Process start (node dist/main.js or tsx src/main.ts) · SIGINT signal · SIGTERM signal

Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite: settings, repos, tasks, agent_runs, side_effects, qa_reviews, notifications, usage_samples) · var/orchestrator.lock (PID file for single-instance guard) · var/repos/ (bare git clones per repo) · var/worktrees/ (git worktrees per task) · SNAPSHOT_DIR (Drive-synced snapshot copies, path from .env)

External I/O: GitHub REST API via gateway (ensureLabels, reconcile issues/PRs, closeIssue, pollAwaitingMerge, pollMergeQueue → mergePr auto-merge) · @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() — called by triage scanner and executor agent pipelines · (assistant/outreach boot) Resend email, Deepgram STT, Kokoro/Deepgram/ElevenLabs TTS, local Ollama (Gemma) — all best-effort, env-gated

p.em: Every state a task moves through from issue ingest to awaiting-human-merge, including all retry, rework, recovery, and cancel edges, enforced via a single atomic transition() function under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

div.p: Triggers: GitHub issue polled/ingested → triage verdict 'ready' → createTask() · Startup reconcile (recoverInFlight) re-drives stranded in_progress/publishing/qa_review tasks · executorTick() scheduler loop fires every TICK_MS (60s) · User dashboard action: retry_task, take_over, cancel_task, requeue, continue_task, handleAnswer · pollAwaitingMerge() detects PR merged or PR closed-unmerged on GitHub

Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite) — tasks table (state, attempt, rework_count, lease_expires_at, branch_name, pr_number, worktree_path, pending_answer, current_session_id) · var/orchestrator.db — task_transitions (append-only audit log: task_id, from_state, to_state, reason, actor) · var/orchestrator.db — side_effects (journaled idempotency log for push_branch, create_pr, add_label) · var/orchestrator.db — triage_results (verdict cache; 'skip' written on done/cancel to prevent re-triage) · var/orchestrator.db — notifications (gating/fyi inbox) · var/orchestrator.db — agent_runs (per-run record with cost, tokens, status) · var/orchestrator.db — qa_reviews (per-persona+summary output per qa_round)

External I/O: GitHub API (gateway.getPr) — pollAwaitingMerge detects merged/closed PRs · GitHub API (gateway.createPr, gateway.listPrFiles) — publish and QA diff fetch · GitHub API (gateway.applyLabel, gateway.removeLabel) — label swaps on transitions · GitHub API (gateway.closeIssue) — cancel_task optionally closes the issue · git CLI via workspace (ensureClone, fetchBase, createWorktree, pushBranch, forcePushBranchWithLease) — workspace management · claude CLI (runAgent via runner.ts) — implement agent and rework agent spawned as child processes · claude CLI (runReviewer, runQaSummary via qaRunner.ts) — QA persona and summary agents · shell exec (execVerify) — optional verifyCommand run in worktree by orchestrator

span.p:
Lease refreshed by heartbeats (30 min window).
Crash: expired lease → recoverInFlight → ready.
Hung (15 min no heartbeat): reaped → aborted → ready.

p.em: Periodic poller and on-demand reconciler both funnel all GitHub issue data through a single syncIssues upsert path into SQLite, with dedup on (id, gh_updated_at, body_hash, state, labels).

div.p: Triggers: setInterval tick every 60 s (poller, staggered per repo) · startup call (reconciler, src/main.ts boot) · POST /api/actions/reconcile (dashboard on-demand backfill)
Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite) — repos table (etag, sync cursors, polled_at), issues table (upserted by syncIssues)

External I/O: GitHub REST API: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?since={since} (conditional with ETag header) · GitHub REST API: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues (unconditional full fetch, reconciler only)

p.em: Conditional paginated issue polling with ETag 304 short-circuit and since-overlap dedup, funnelled through a single syncIssues upsert, with the PAT owned exclusively by the gateway.

div.p: Triggers: setInterval tick (TICK_MS = 60s) per enabled repo, staggered by i * interval / N · startup reconcile (unconditional full fetch) · POST /api/actions/reconcile (on-demand dashboard backfill)
Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite): repos table (issues_etag, last_issue_sync_at, last_polled_at, last_full_reconcile_at), issues table (upserted by syncIssues)

External I/O: GitHub REST API: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues (conditional with If-None-Match, paginated, state=all sort=updated direction=desc per_page=100) · GitHub REST API: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls (find-before-create in createPr) · GitHub REST API: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number} (getPr) · GitHub REST API: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/files (listPrFiles, paginated)

p.em: Every GitHub mutation is journaled (intent row written to side_effects BEFORE the call), executed sequentially via awaited async calls within a pipeline, with find-before-create on retry and 422-already-exists treated as success.

div.p: Triggers: Agent task reaches 'publishing' state (executor pipeline) · Triage verdict applies a label (triageScanner) · Repo registration calls ensureLabels · Recovery re-drives stalled 'publishing' tasks (redrivePublishing) · Dashboard action calls closeIssue
Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite) — side_effects table: idempotency_key, kind, state, github_result_ref, payload_json, repo_id, task_id

External I/O: GitHub REST API — POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls (create PR) · GitHub REST API — GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls (find-before-create) · GitHub REST API — POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/labels (apply label) · GitHub REST API — DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/labels/{label} (remove label) · GitHub REST API — POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels (ensure label) · GitHub REST API — PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number} (close issue) · git push via workspace.pushBranch (uses GitHub PAT in remote URL)

p.em: Serial scanner queries Claude SDK for each untriaged issue, caches the verdict by (issue_id, body_hash), and routes ready/needs_interview/skip/failed to task creation, gating notifications, or GitHub labels.

div.p: Triggers: setInterval every 60 s (TICK_MS) · immediate tick on startTriageScanner() boot

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — issues (body_hash cache key) · var/orchestrator.db — triage_results (issue_id, body_hash, verdict, reasons_json, missing_info_json) · var/orchestrator.db — agent_runs (stage=triage, status, cost_usd, tokens, session_id) · var/orchestrator.db — tasks (createTask writes here on ready verdict) · var/orchestrator.db — notifications (insertGating / resolveNotification) · var/orchestrator.db — side_effects (applyLabel/removeLabel journaled by gateway)

External I/O: Claude Agent SDK query() — @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (subscription OAuth, no API key) · GitHub REST API — applyLabel (POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/labels) · GitHub REST API — removeLabel (DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/labels/{name})

p.em: Every scheduling tick gate-checks pause/cost-ceiling/headroom, then issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE transitions to claim ready tasks oldest-first within per-repo and global caps, while a hung-agent reaper aborts in-flight tasks whose heartbeat is stale and crash-recovery re-queues tasks whose lease has expired.

div.p: Triggers: setInterval every TICK_MS (60 s) fires executorTick via startExecutor · boot: recoverInFlight called once with empty skip-set before first tick

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — tasks table (state, lease_expires_at, last_heartbeat_at, branch_name, current_session_id) · var/orchestrator.db — task_transitions append-only audit log · var/orchestrator.db — settings k/v (paused, headroom_floor_pct, temp_cap_bump, temp_cap_bump_expires_at, cost_ceiling_per_day) · var/orchestrator.db — usage_samples (sampled_at, five_hour_pct) · var/orchestrator.db — notifications (gating and FYI rows)

External I/O: GitHub REST API via gateway.getPr() — called by pollAwaitingMerge to check PR merged/closed state · claude CLI child process — launched by runTaskPipeline after a successful claim (not in scheduler itself)

tasks WHERE in_progress

p.em: Manages bare clones per repo and linked worktrees per task, with credential-isolated git operations, startup orphan pruning, and worktree branch re-pointing on retry attempts.

div.p: Triggers: Task claimed (in_progress): runTaskPipeline invoked · Boot/tick: recoverInFlight invoked · retry_task action: attempt counter bumped, new branchName generated · publish path: redrivePublishing invoked

Stores: SQLite var/orchestrator.db (tables: tasks, side_effects, agent_runs, repos) · var/repos/{repoId}/ — bare git clone per repo · var/worktrees/{taskId}/ — linked worktree per task · var/git-askpass.sh — credential helper script (mode 0700)

External I/O: git clone --bare (via GIT_ASKPASS authEnv) · git remote set-url origin · git fetch (fetchBase / fetchBranch) · git worktree add / remove --force · git branch --show-current · git checkout -B HEAD (retry re-point) · git ls-remote --heads (pushBranch idempotency check) · git push (pushBranch / forcePushBranchWithLease) · git rev-parse refs/heads/ (ensureBranchFromWorktree / getBranchSha) · git rev-list --count ..HEAD (ensureBranchFromWorktree) · git branch (ensureBranchFromWorktree rebuild) · github.com GitHub API via GithubGateway (createPr, getPr, applyLabel)

p.em: A timer-driven concurrent pool claims ready tasks from SQLite, spawns one detached pipeline per task that drives the Claude Agent SDK to implement the issue in a git worktree, then publishes the branch, runs QA, and recovers from crashes via lease-based re-queuing.

div.p: Triggers: setInterval every 60 s (TICK_MS) in startExecutor · Immediate first tick on startExecutor call · Boot-time recoverInFlight call from main.ts

Stores: var/orchestrator.db (tables: tasks, agent_runs, side_effects, notifications, repos, issues) · var/logs/agent-run-task{id}-{ts}.log (raw SDK stream, mode 0o600) · var/worktrees/{taskId}/ (git worktree per task) · var/repos/{repoId}/ (bare clone per repo)

External I/O: Agent SDK query() — async-iterator stream over CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN · workspace.pushBranch() — git push to GitHub remote · gateway.createPr() — GitHub REST API POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls · gateway.getPr() — GitHub REST API GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number} · gateway.applyLabel() / removeLabel() — GitHub REST API label mutations · runRebaseCascade() — per-repo rebase cascade after merge detection

span.p:
SQLite
orchestrator.db
tasks / agent_runs
side_effects / notifications

p.em: Sequential reviewer personas produce free-form markdown, a strict CTO-summary persona emits a Zod-validated {ship|rework} JSON verdict, and dispatchQa drives a bounded rework loop (default max 2 cycles) that re-runs the implement agent in-place before looping back through QA — no GitHub posting at any point.

div.p: Triggers: Task enters qa_review state after publish() transitions publishing → qa_review · Crash-recovery (recoverInFlight) re-drives dispatchQa for stranded qa_review tasks · pipeline.ts calls dispatchQa() immediately after publish completes

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — tables: qa_reviews (task_id, attempt, qa_round, persona_id, verdict, output_md), agent_runs (task_id, issue_id, role_id, stage, pid, model, status, cost_usd, tokens, session_id), notifications (gating FYI rows), tasks (state, rework_count, worktree_path, pr_number, current_session_id), repos (owner, name, config_json)

External I/O: github API — gateway.getPr() (mergeability check, read-only) · github API — gateway.listPrFiles() (diff fetch, read-only) · github API — safeApplyLabel / safeRemoveLabel (on ship only, via serialized write queue) · @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() — one call per reviewer persona (free-form markdown) · @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() — one call for qa-summary (strict JSON verdict) · shell exec — verifyCommand in worktree (orchestrator-executed, scrubbed env, 10-min timeout, only if repo defines verifyCommand) · claude agent runner (runAgent) — implement role re-run during rework

p.em: System-wide notification center persisting two-tier (gating/fyi) rows in SQLite with typed action_json payloads; dashboard reads via REST+SSE and dispatches user choices back through handleAction/handleAnswer which resolve the notification and mutate task state atomically.

div.p: Triggers: Agent pipeline events (blocker, failure, escalation) · QA stage completion (ship, rework, escalate) · Executor tick gates (cost_ceiling, headroom_deferral, queue_full, hung_agent) · Triage scanner outcomes (interview_needed, triage_failed) · Dashboard user actions via POST /api/actions or POST /api/answer

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — notifications table (kind, subkind, task_id, issue_id, repo_id, dedupe_key, title, body, action_json, status, answer_text) · var/orchestrator.db — tasks table (state, attempt, branch_name, pending_answer, current_session_id) · var/orchestrator.db — triage_results table (skip rows inserted on cancel_task) · var/orchestrator.db — settings table (temp_bump_cap, temp_bump_granted_via, temp_bump_expires_at written by bump_cap action)
External I/O: GitHub API — closeIssue() called fire-and-forget after cancel_task commits · SSE push to dashboard clients via EventBus.emitNotification()

p.em: Express server on 127.0.0.1 serves a REST API and a single SSE stream (/api/events) that pushes sync and notification events to the React dashboard, which refetches data over REST on each event.

div.p: Triggers: HTTP GET/POST from browser (React dashboard SPA) · SSE connection open from dashboard useEvents hook · Internal emitSync() call from ingest/reconcile poller · Internal emitNotification() call from action handlers, settings writes, or transition hooks
Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite — repos, issues, tasks, task_transitions, notifications, triage_results, agent_runs, qa_reviews, settings, usage_samples tables)
External I/O: GitHub API (via gateway, only for reconcile/backfill/closeIssue routes) · filesystem: dashboard/dist/ (static SPA served by express.static)

p.em: Usage samples are ingested via REST into usage_samples, aggregates are computed on-demand from agent_runs at GET /api/stats, DB snapshots are written via VACUUM INTO on a timer to /mnt/c, and terminal task artifacts are pruned daily.

div.p: Triggers: HTTP GET /api/stats (dashboard poll) · HTTP POST /api/stats/ingest (external headroom poster) · setInterval TICK_MS snapshot loop (main.ts boot) · setInterval TICK_MS daily retention tick (main.ts, after ingest startup) · boot-time one-shot retention prune (main.ts after workspace init)

Stores: var/orchestrator.db (SQLite) — tables: usage_samples, agent_runs, task_transitions, qa_reviews, settings, tasks, notifications · var/snapshot-tmp/ (ext4 staging dir for VACUUM INTO) · SNAPSHOT_DIR (/mnt/c Drive-synced path) — final snapshot files: orchestrator-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss.db · var/worktrees/{taskId}/ — per-task git worktrees removed by retention · var/logs/ — per-run log files removed by retention (paths stored in agent_runs.log_path)

External I/O: filesystem: VACUUM INTO (node:sqlite) to ext4 staging path · filesystem: fs.readFileSync + fs.writeFileSync cross-device copy to /mnt/c (avoids copy_file_range EPERM on 9P drvfs) · filesystem: fs.renameSync atomic rename within SNAPSHOT_DIR · filesystem: fs.rmSync for staging cleanup, old snapshots, and log files · filesystem: workspace.removeWorktree(taskId) removes var/worktrees/{taskId} via git worktree remove

p.em: createArgus (boot.ts) assembles one brain session shared by all entry points; every user utterance flows through createSession.send → createGemmaFirstChat (local Gemma via Ollama) → escalation decision → createPersistentChat (Sonnet via Claude Agent SDK), with untrusted-input enveloping on tool reads, a confirm/confirmerCore gate on consequential tool calls, and a per-turn onRoute tier tag emitted as a side channel.

div.p: Triggers: User utterance from REPL (repl.ts readline loop) · Voice utterance transcribed by Deepgram (voice.ts) · HTTP POST /api/argus/chat from dashboard (argusRoutes.ts via webArgus.ts)

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — facts table (loadFacts / remember / forget) · var/orchestrator.db — usage_samples (recordUsageSample source=assistant) · In-memory session history (Session.history, lost on restart)

External I/O: Ollama REST POST /api/chat (local Gemma model, no network) · Claude Agent SDK query() — subscription OAuth via CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (Sonnet subprocess, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) · Deepgram STT REST (voice.ts only) · TTS synth via createSpeechPipeline (voice / web only)

p.em: Three surfaces feed utterances into a single shared Argus brain and render its replies: a terminal REPL (npm run argus), a voice loop with Deepgram STT + sentence-chunked TTS (npm run argus:voice), and an HTTP-served web surface (createWebArgus + createWebConfirmer); a proactive announcer (createAnnouncer) speaks gating notifications without a brain round-trip.

div.p: Triggers: npm run argus → repl.ts readline loop · npm run argus:voice → voice.ts readline/record loop · main.ts boot → createWebArgus wired to Express argusRoutes · bus.onNotification / TICK_MS setInterval → createAnnouncer.scan()

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — notifications table (announced_at stamp) · var/orchestrator.db — usage_samples (recordUsageSample per turn) · var/orchestrator.db — settings (argus_announce, paused, argus_quiet_start/end read by announcer)

External I/O: Deepgram STT REST API (/v1/listen) — mic PCM → transcript · Deepgram Aura TTS REST API (/v1/speak) — text → PCM/MP3 · ElevenLabs TTS REST API (/v1/text-to-speech) — optional cloud voice · Kokoro-FastAPI local HTTP (/v1/audio/speech) — offline fallback voice · parec (PulseAudio) — mic capture · paplay (PulseAudio) — speaker playback · Argus brain session (Claude Agent SDK via createPersistentChat / gemmaFirst Ollama)

p.em: startPhoneServer boots an Express+WebSocket server on 0.0.0.0:7443 that token-gates every connection, bridges a phone PWA client through STT → Argus brain → streaming TTS, and handles gated action confirmations via createMutablePhoneConfirmer.

div.p: Triggers: main.ts boot calls startPhoneServer(deps) · phone PWA connects WS /ws · phone sends start_listening / audio_frame / stop_listening / text_input / confirm_yes / cancel_confirmation · GET /api/tts/:id from phone element
Stores: in-process TtsCache (Map<id, {buf, expiresAt}>, TTL 5 min, max 200 entries, non-evicting on read — iOS double-GET safety)

External I/O: STT provider via injected transcribe(pcm: Buffer) · TTS provider via injected synth(text) (MP3) and optional pcmSynth(text) (PCM for orb envelope) · Argus brain session via session.send(transcript, onChunk) · phone PWA client over WebSocket · GET /api/tts/:id served over HTTP

div.h2: 18. Email — Outbound Gateway and Inbound Webhook

p.em: Outbound: createEmailGateway serialises Resend sends through a single promise-chain queue, journaling each intent as a pending side_effect before the call and advancing batch_items to 'sent' on success; inbound: POST /api/email/event verifies Svix signatures and flips consent_state to 'suppressed' on bounce/complaint/unsubscribe, blocking all future sends to that contact.

div.p: Triggers: Dashboard action approve_batch_emails (handleAction in actions.ts) · Boot reDrivePending() re-drives all pending send_email side_effects rows · POST /api/email/event from Resend (bounce / complaint / unsubscribe)

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — side_effects (kind='send_email', idempotency_key='batchitem:{id}:email', state pending→done/failed) · var/orchestrator.db — batch_items (state: email_pending→email_approved→sent / skipped; consent_state→'suppressed'; last_error) · var/orchestrator.db — notifications (insertFyi: email_suppressed / email_daily_cap_hit / email_event_unmatched)

External I/O: Resend REST API — POST https://api.resend.com/emails (Idempotency-Key header, Bearer EMAIL_API_KEY) · Resend webhook events — POST /api/email/event (Svix HMAC-SHA256 signature, RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET)

p.em: createBatchWorker drives batch_items depth-first through research → build delegation → email draft → human approval → email send, triggered each TICK_MS interval and on every bus.onNotification event. Discovery (discoveryRunner) is a separate one-shot tool called by start_batch before batch_items exist — it is NOT part of the worker tick loop.

div.p: Triggers: batchTickInterval (TICK_MS setInterval) · bus.onNotification subscription (unsubBatchNotification) wakes worker on any notification change

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — batches (id, status, budget_usd, consec_fails, policy_json, intent) · var/orchestrator.db — batch_items (state, research_ref, issue_id, task_id, mockup_url, email_draft_md, email_confidence, last_error) · var/orchestrator.db — side_effects (kind=send_email, idempotency_key, payload_json, state) · var/orchestrator.db — notifications (subkind: batch_email_approval, batch_circuit_breaker, batch_budget_exceeded) · var/research/.json (24h ResearchArtifact cache)

External I/O: Claude Agent SDK query() — research persona (haiku + web tools, maxTurns=10) for per-item research · Claude Agent SDK query() — draft-email persona (haiku, maxTurns=5) for email_draft_md · GitHub REST API — gateway.createIssue() mints build issue in solafidei/argus-demo (journaled side_effects) · emailGateway.enqueueEmail() via Resend (EMAIL_API_KEY) on approve

p.em: When pollAwaitingMerge detects a merged PR, runRebaseCascade fetches the updated base and merges it into every other open awaiting_merge branch on the same repo, running the Sonnet merge-resolver agent on conflicts and escalating to a gating notification only when auto-resolve fails or a semantic decision is needed.

div.p: Triggers: pollAwaitingMerge detects PR merged (bulk cascade) · Dashboard "Rebase now" action → rebaseTaskNow (single-task) · qaDispatch detects dirty PR in qa_review → healTaskMergeConflict (single-task, opt-in per repo.rebaseCascade)

Stores: var/orchestrator.db — tasks (worktree_path update on recreate) · var/orchestrator.db — side_effects (journaled push_branch rows, idempotency_key = push:{taskId}:{anchorSha}) · var/orchestrator.db — notifications (insertGating merge_conflict / insertFyi merge_done) · var/repos/{repoId}/ (bare clone, ensureClone + fetchBase) · var/worktrees/{taskId}/ (worktree, mergeBranch, resetBranchToSha)

External I/O: GitHub REST API — getPr (mergeability probe, SPEC §13.3) · GitHub REST API — workspace.fetchBase / fetchBranch / pushBranch (git over HTTPS with PAT) · Claude Agent SDK — runAgent stage=merge_resolve via MERGE_RESOLVER_ROLE persona (Sonnet, resolverPrompt + conflict markers / @@BLOCKER@@ sentinel) · Shell — execVerify (repo.verifyCommand, scrubbed env, 10-min timeout)
